summary: Keep fixture boundary inspection strict when SQLite removes a transient sidecar

replay.detail: Only the CI/evaluation filesystem boundary scanner and its regression controls change; claim projection and replay do not change.

schema.detail: No database schema, table, index or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination requirements change.

compatibility.detail: No product API, peer, client or harness contract changes. A vanished SQLite -wal/-shm is tolerated only after the matching database records and schemas were inspected; generated-path findings, live SQLite semantic checks and all other missing-file or I/O errors retain existing failure behavior.

downtime.detail: The bounded fixture scanner introduces no service interruption or runtime restart requirement.

manual.detail: No existing-installation action, state conversion or budget change is required.

recovery.detail: No state or runtime recovery change; binary swap-back needs no data conversion.
